selection.policy: Development set only: require all queries valid; maximize mean context target-file coverage at level 2 / budget 8000, then primary file hit@1, then primary-file MRR. Exact ties prefer IDF lexical, then BM25 files, then RRF, then RRF+MMR. The frozen legacy policy is a comparator, not an eligible new default. Write the selection lock before evaluating any holdout query. Do not tune on holdout.

strategy_experiment.validation_reuse_reason: The initial locked experiment already evaluated Orion. This rerun validates an independently discovered regular-plural tokenizer bug fix; Orion is previously seen validation, not a fresh holdout. The original experiment and rejected score calibration remain retained.
limits: Legacy has better development top-one/MRR than IDF. Selection was among new candidates only.
All policies share the improved context packer; this is not a full old/new application comparison.
Orion is reused validation in the final run.
No per-mechanism source-packing/normalization ablation or embeddings evaluation was performed.

limits.pairing: Exact task ID, language, immutable fixture commit, expected declarations, session prompt and actual retrieval query/level/budget sequence
limits.coverage: Declared target-file and declaration visibility proxies; not semantic completeness or coding success
limits.resources: Single sequential observations, not randomized repeated performance trials. Sampled CPU is an observed lower bound; sampled RSS may double-count shared pages. Every numerical increase in time/CPU/RSS is listed as an observed regression, without claiming statistical significance.
limits.source_provenance: Source capture and historical reconstruction are distinguished; unknown versions remain unknown
limits.caching: Fresh databases per probe; provider cache is irrelevant because no model is invoked. Host filesystem caches are uncontrolled.
limits.token_budget: Configured estimated-token budget; not measured or billed model tokens

large_index_frequency_comparison.conditions: Same process, DB, source bytes, query, refresh=False and limit=20. Shared unflushed OS/SQLite caches; alternate order in repeat 2. Process CPU only; no model, cost, remote resource or exact filesystem-read telemetry. Prior implementation uses the retained project_id-payload COUNT query; optimized uses exact vocabulary or row-ID membership.

rank_equivalence.scope: Exact candidate/rank/score equivalence after document-frequency optimization. Previously evaluated development/validation queries; no independent new holdout, model calls or timing comparison.

codex_ab.blocker: HTTP 401; supplied Codex authentication token cannot be refreshed and requires sign-in again.

overhead.method: /proc sampling; CPU observed lower bound, RSS shared pages can be counted multiple times; short-lived processes may be missed

telemetry.file_read_method: Heuristic command-intent proxy from successful command_execution items containing literal cat, sed -n, head, tail, or rg commands with explicit file-like paths. Shell expansion, scripts, directory searches, MCP reads, and internal reads are excluded. A repeated command names a path recognized in an earlier command. This is not an I/O trace, an actual read count, or a guaranteed lower bound on filesystem reads.
telemetry.mcp_count_scope: Observed unique invocation items; total only for complete parsed streams, otherwise a lower bound
telemetry.model_calls_unavailable_reason: Codex exec JSONL exposes completed turns, not underlying provider/API model calls
telemetry.repeated_file_reads_unavailable_reason: Codex JSONL does not expose a filesystem I/O trace; command text cannot establish actual reads

telemetry.usage_scope: Complete parsed stream only; partial observed turn usage is stored separately
